items.text: A regular on this board says his brother-in-law sits on the clearing desk at a mid-size broker, and he puts the man's words in quotes: "the small-cap settlement backlog is three times what the exchange publishes." He has been asked twice to name the broker, and so far he has not.
有未具名知情人士转述称，部分省级职业年金账户的当期支付缺口存在递延确认的情形，本公司对此无法核实；在受托人正式披露之前，该说法能否成立？

Bonded copper stocks in Guangdong are close to twice the level shown in official exchange data, two people with direct knowledge of the warehousing arrangements said, both speaking on condition of anonymity because the figures are not public.
据说来自不愿具名的承销人士、关于部分城投平台“隐性担保并未写入募集说明书”的说法，是本文要讨论的第一个争议点，也是持有人与发行人在展期谈判中反复引用的那一句。

Read the payroll-revision thread doing the rounds before you repeat it anywhere: the figures come from a person who says he saw the draft tables, and nobody has been able to confirm a single line of them.
据未具名交易员反映，离岸人民币三个月远期点数被指受到人为压低，不过该说法无法被独立核实，我们在定价模型中亦未予采用。

Should the allocation figure being passed around on the dealer chat lines be accurate, the fund's private-credit sleeve would already sit above the ceiling printed in its own fact sheet. The ceiling we publish has not changed.
据接近公司的人士称，四季度渠道库存的回补速度可能慢于财报披露的口径；公司方面对该说法未予置评。

A user with a blue check in our group swears his cousin runs a validator and reports him as saying, "the foundation quietly moved a chunk of treasury coins last month." No address and no screenshot has appeared since, in any of the three threads where it was repeated.
有未具名人士称，本集团若干商业物业的租金回收率被高估，上述说法出自何处本公司无从核实，相关独立复核的结论尚未形成？
